decisions.reason: High investment in an executive desk system central to the announced workplace flexibility direction creates strong escalation pressure to persist.
As a chair family close to the established core, its sunk costs and public commitment make dropping very unlikely.
Floor cushions are a less central accessory with relatively low investment, so escalation pressures are weaker and a drop is more likely.
The designer sofa has visible public design collaboration and is central to the living segment, reinforcing commitment.
The high standing table is close to the established offer and fits workplace flexibility, so moderate visibility and sunk costs favor keeping.
Although distant from the established offer, the rug collection is a visible strategic expansion with sunk investment, so escalation favors persistence.
